title: Shared branded Vulkan overlay test
purpose: Review welcome placement, typography, accent readability and compact feature measurements on the installed replacement; verify runtime behavior separately from visual acceptance.

questions.prompt: Is the welcome toast centered with comfortable space above it, and is the keycap clearly smaller than the rtxForge icon?
questions.reason: Direct user request for top-center placement, extra top padding, official icon/wordmark and smaller shortcut glyph.

questions.prompt: Are the Bakbak One app/game headings and the compact NR/FG measurements easy to read without crowding the controls?
questions.reason: Use official typography and present live values near their feature toggles.

checklist.label: Hide and show live statistics in the panel settings.
checklist.reason: Observe the visibility preference while leaving NR/FG controls available.

checklist.label: Repeat the visual check in BG3 and RDR2.
checklist.reason: Same runtime/provider needs separate game acceptance.

Both game installations and helper hashes verified; known good configurations preserved.

Diagnostics reads the named channel and native logs; no desktop input or debugger.
User closes BG3 before the separate RDR2 launch.
recovery: Retained candidate07 runtime/common Bink and original recovery journals; RDR2 ReflexSleep remains 0.
Previous app/settings backup retained in allocated task artifacts.
